references: Four existing full-body combat poses per sheet, in row order. User supplied an arms-crossed portrait as the pose reference.
prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production fighting-game transparent sprite atlas.
Use the attached four-character lineup as the identity and costume reference, in order: zavarce, vallenilla, javier, capriles. Create ONE atlas with EXACTLY 6 columns and 4 rows, 24 separate full-body figures, 3072x2048 landscape canvas. Each cell is 512x512. Row 1 ONLY zavarce, row 2 ONLY vallenilla, row 3 ONLY javier, row 4 ONLY capriles. Every figure comfortably fits its cell with generous transparent gutters. No labels, lettering, grid lines, objects, phones, cards, particle effects, ground shadows or background. Genuine transparent alpha.
In each row the SAME character performs this sequential entrance, left to right: (1) beginning to stand upright, fists lowered from guard; (2) fully standing tall, shoulders back, arms relaxed down; (3) elbows bend and both forearms begin lifting across stomach; (4) one forearm rests horizontally across chest while the other moves in; (5) second forearm folds over first, almost crossed; (6) final confident defiant ARMS CROSSED firmly across chest, hands tucked against opposite upper arms, chin slightly raised. It is a calm challenging stance, like an arms-crossed portrait. Character looks towards screen right throughout, body three-quarter front, never turns around. Feet in same planted shoulder-width stance and baseline through all 6 cells. No dancing, waving, punches or props.
Match each reference face, hair, skin tone, outfit, glasses and shoes precisely. Preserve zavarce's rectangular glasses, light blue unzipped jacket, black shirt and dark trousers. Preserve vallenilla's receding hair, blue checked rolled-sleeve shirt and navy trousers. Preserve javier's black T-shirt, dark trousers and stylized head. Preserve capriles's exact Venezuelan tricolor baseball cap, gray button shirt and blue jeans. Same crisp outlined shaded 2D game illustration style as reference, consistent character size and anatomy through every row, only arms/upper posture change. Both shoulders, elbows, wrists, hands and shoes intact in every pose.
